title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct intensity of moonlight on Earth in watts per cm^2.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct number of photons per cm^2 per second in the visible range.

title: Use of Solar Constant
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly identify and use the solar constant value in their calculations.

title: Solid Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The student must correctly calculate the solid angle subtended by the Earth at the Moon.

title: Photon Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly calculate the energy of a photon using the appropriate wavelength.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria - The student could discuss limiting cases or assumptions made in the problem.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common sign mistakes in their calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should not omit any necessary factors in their calculations, such as the geometry of the problem.
